From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@signet.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Impact on Sep 20 inference window — request for SLA credit details

Attached: credit-calculation-worksheet.xlsx

Quick notes on methodology (so Signet has transparency):
- Monthly billing minutes for September 2026 (30 days): 30 days * 24 hrs * 60 = 43,200 minutes.
- Redwood SLA threshold for "available" is 99.95% per month, corresponding to max allowable downtime of ~21.6 minutes/month.
- Observed downtime attributable to Redwood (post-triage): 76 minutes.
- For credit calculation we net allowed downtime: 76 - 21.6 = 54.4 minutes subject to credit.
- Credit percentage = (net downtime) / total monthly minutes = 54.4 / 43200 = 0.001259 -> 0.1259% of monthly recurring charges (MRC).

Example applied to Signet's MRC: if MRC = $50,000 for Sep, proposed credit = $62.95 (rounded). Worksheet shows per-route breakdown (tails, retries, and token-unit prorating).

I'll flag that the formula above is the standard remediation path in our SLA; if Signet prefers an alternate rounding or minimum credit thresholds, we can discuss.

- Connor
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
